nom: Uriage Eau Thermale Water Cream, Face Moisturizer With Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I've been using this for a year now and can't live without it now, my skin loves it, I have oily skin, and love that this does not create breakouts. I love how light it is yet moisturizes my face neck and chest. Love that it does not have over powering perfume scent. This is delicately pleasant and clean smelling.

I have sensitive skin (which can also be combination skin). I use this during the day and LOVE it! I originally found it in Montreal and was thrilled when I found it on Amazon!! They have a light version and a rich version. I have both to use depending on the season. THE BEST!

The perfect light hydrator for active teen skin or male skin that doesn’t like the feeling of a heavy hydrator. Is made with incredibly high EU standards and is thermal water based which helps calm and cool. The skin also. Absorbs very easily and lightly into the skin.

I am extremely fussy about the texture of my face moisturizer, and this lightweight gel-cream has a lovely texture. The scent is so pretty strong though. I would definitely prefer for it to be unscented. I am currently on prescription tretinoin hydroquinone from my dermatologist so my skin is dry and sensitive. Prior to being on this I had combo skin. This gel-cream is light but gives enough moisture without me feeling greasy. I have sensory issues and I cannot deal with a greasy face. It takes about one to two minutes to fully sink in to your skin and then it absorbs really well without leaving a greasy layer on top of your skin. I had no issues with this breaking me out, making me sensitive and it was fine around my eye area. It works fine under sunscreen and makeup. I scent eventually goes away but I wish it wasn’t there to begin with. If you have combo skin and are looking for something light but also very hydrating I would recommend this. If you hate scented skincare I would skip this one.
I love the lightweight feel and how moisturized my skin feels when I use this product. Nice gentle scent, not overpowering. Great for everyday use.
This product was recommended to me by my dermatologist. I use it before I apply my moisturizer especially in the winter months. It works great.

I've been using this cream every day, and I'm very happy with it. It provides great hydration, absorbs quickly, and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. My skin feels soft, smooth, and comfortable all day. I have combination skin, and it works perfectly for me. I highly recommend it and will definitely purchase it again!

Perfecta textura, hidrata sin ser nada pesada. Ideal si usas protección solar después. Para la noche después de un serum de vitaminas, o sola si tu piel es joven o necesitas algo simple, está muy bien.
Très bien ! Avec une texture agréable sur la peau. Il complète bien ma Skin Care ( ma routine quotidienne).

I have an oily skin and it is difficult sometimes to find the right cream which hydrates but does not leave you with a shiny face. This Uriage Cream is very good in leaving you a nice, hydrated but dry looking face and neck, minimising small wrinkles and giving you a fresh daily start or a smooth face for the night.
I LOVE THIS PRODUCT and just purchased the cleaner same brand LOVE IT
Super crème, elle laisse la peau douce et bien hydratée tout au long de la journée. Très agréable à utiliser.
